title: Fun with segway
text: this was an amazing adventure and a great way to see the city of Barcelona. Our tour guide illia did a fantastic job and very very good at explaining things talking about the city and also making sure you had a great time
author: AMIR_G

title: Definitely do this tour
text: This was a very fun experience. We got a good overview of Barcelona and saw sites we definitely want to see closer up. The Segways were great and our guide was wonderful. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour
author: Liz_F

title: Great Segway tour
text: We hadn’t been on a Segway tour or even been on a Segway before. It was easy to grasp and all 3 of us loved it. We covered a good distance and Oriol (our guide) was really helpful. He was very educational when we stopped and included our 11 year old daughter in the conversations. He was very nice and helped us a lot. He also took some photos for us. We went around port Olympic and the Ciutadella park. We’ll be getting Segway tours in cities we go to now and if we go back to Barcelona we will look to book a different tour with same people.
author: khadley06

title: Fun Aftetnoon!
text: Loads of fun and would definitely do it again. Our guide was great and you get to see a lot of the city.
author: Scott_B

title: Great Sagway tour.
text: We had a very nice tour companion, Anke, it was a beautiful tour with the Sagway, we would be happy to do it again anytime.
author: 421dilarac

title: Barcelona on Segway
text: We had a great Segway tour with Adriana today, who we can only highly recommend as a tour guide. Adriana told us a lot and interesting things about the history of Barcelona. Thanks Adriana 🥰👍🏻🫶🏻
author: stefanfM2052JD

title: Thrilling
text: Our guide was patient, kind, funny and knowledgeable about the city and it’s landmarks. The experience was exciting we had so much fun.
author: Flyer31687348466

title: A fantastic experience!
text: This was genuinely fun experience! We were a group of 6. We arrived and were greeted by a friendly team who organised us efficiently. We had a 10 min training session and then we were on our way. Our guide (Jordy) was really friendly and enhanced the whole experience. We went through the park, along the seafront and through the city. There was no rush and we all felt safe at all times. We enjoyed it so much we wanted to take another tour in the afternoon!! (unfortunatly we didnt have time).
author: richardhK2472ON

title: Just great!
text: Anna was a great travel guide. It was so fun with her. It was all so straightforward and simple. She knew a lot and spoke perfect German. Super nice and personable! We would come back immediately and make a tour. Thank you for the great Service!
author: Amo230510

title: Recommended fun and engaging tour
text:
Our tour guides Mireia and Helena were very knowledgeable, and kept the tour fun and engaging :)

We would recommend this tour
